subject: Commitment cadence drift — MAP amendments & escalation
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@nimbusretail.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@nimbusretail.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Mar 2028 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP and evaluation timing — hold on close

Jordan —

Thanks for the call earlier. Quick update from our side: procurement has pushed our PO approval window out by two weeks (internal budget review + an exec restructure). That means the close date we discussed is at risk unless we compress the evaluation window.

We attached the evaluation matrix we used for the last POC so you can see which tests are required. If Redwood can provide a pre-configured evaluation image and 2 days of SE support during our test window, we can run an accelerated verification and try to hit a revised close target.

Attaching: evaluation_matrix_v2.xlsx

Can you confirm what flexibility you have on the MAP dates and whether you can commit an SE for an accelerated window?

—Ellen
Ellen Park
Head of Data Platforms, Nimbus Retail

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@nimbusretail.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Mar 2028 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP and evaluation timing — hold on close

Ellen —

Thanks for flagging this. Appreciate the transparency — we can work with procurement pushes if we align on mitigations now. Two quick paths we can offer:

1) Re-baseline: Move the MAP milestones and formal close by two weeks. We’ll update the MAP and shift rollout dates.
2) Keep the current close: Provide a pre-configured eval AMI, a dedicated SE two-day acceleration window, and a temporary Dedicated slot for peak throughput during your verification. In exchange, we’ll ask for an agreed follow-up SOW and a short extension on billing start (if PO slips).

I attached an updated MAP draft (Mutual_Action_Plan_v3.xlsx) showing both options side-by-side. Please confirm which you prefer. If you pick option 2, we need written confirmation on the expedited test dates and who on your side will own the PO approval.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/9347

Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Mutual_Action_Plan_v3.xlsx
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Mar 2028 11:35:00 -0700
Subject: RE: MAP and evaluation timing — internal risk assessment

Team —

Quick risk log note for the MAP:
- Risk ID: RISK-20280302-01
- Title: Evaluation window compression increases regression risk and may surface edge-case latency issues under production load.
- Likelihood: Medium
- Impact: High (could delay final sign-off if failures occur)
- Mitigation: Offer a temporary Dedicated slot for the test window + prioritize smoke tests and our top 3 latency scenarios; provide SE runbook and on-call for the two-day window.

If we proceed with option 2 (accelerated), we should lock in:
- Confirmation of expedited test dates (Ellen to confirm)
- Assigned SE (I can take day 1; suggest Mary L. for day 2)
- 48-hour SLA for hotfixes during test window (we can offer this as a paid add-on or apply a one-time operational credit).

I recommend we also prepare a short exec note for Ben to approve a PRICING exception (2-week credit or deferred billing start) if necessary.

—Marcus
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@nimbusretail.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@nimbusretail.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Mar 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP and evaluation timing — hold on close

Jordan / Marcus —

We can commit to an accelerated window if Redwood provides the pre-configured image and SE coverage as you suggested. Marco will own PO approval but warned that his executive sign-off meeting is on 3/10; he requested a 1-week extension on the PO approval date to account for potential redlines.

Concrete next steps from our side:
- We can run an accelerated smoke + functional matrix on 3/6–3/7 if you can provide the image by 3/5.
- We can accept a one-time operational credit against month 1 if that helps bridge the PO gap.
- We will send SOW redlines (if any) by COB 3/4.

Attaching: evaluation_matrix_v2.xlsx (for reference)

Ellen
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 3 Mar 2028 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: MAP and evaluation timing — pricing exception request

Jordan / Ben —

If the customer will run the accelerated window 3/6–3/7, we can offer the following to keep the close intact and reduce exec friction:
- Temporary operational credit equal to two weeks of hosting (applied to month 1).
- Defer billing start by 14 days if PO is delayed.
- Short-term Dedicated slot at no cost for the test window.

I’ve prepared a short pricing exception request form for Ben’s approval (pricing_exception_request.docx). Ben — can you approve an exception up to $12k for this bridge? If approved, I’ll finalize MAP_v3-final and the DocuSign envelope for signature.

—Priya
Director, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ellen Park <ellen.park@nimbusretail.com>, Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@nimbusretail.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Mar 2028 10:11:00 -0700
Subject: Escalation: Commitment cadence drift — proposed fix and ask for sign-off

Ben —

Summary: Nimbus (Ellen / Marco) reported a procurement timing drift that threatens the previously agreed close. They will run an accelerated evaluation 3/6–3/7 if we provide a pre-built image by 3/5 and SE coverage for the two days. They have pushed PO approval to 3/10 and asked for a 1-week extension.

Proposed internal decision (asks for your sign-off):
- Approve pricing exception up to $12k (operational credit + deferred billing start).
- Approve temporary Dedicated slot for 3/6–3/7.
- Finalize MAP_v3-final and push DocuSign envelope today (link below).

Believed outcome: Keeps close date effectively intact (conditional on successful accelerated tests) and reduces risk of the deal slipping into next quarter.

Attachments: MAP_v3-final.xlsx, pricing_exception_request.docx
Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/9347, https://docusign.net/envelope/ABC123

Please reply with APPROVE or DENY and any constraints. If I don’t hear back by 1:00pm PT I’ll assume tentative approval to proceed with operational prep (SE booking + image build) and escalate to executive contact list.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
